```yaml
name: PyInstaller macOS Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14 # Apple Silicon runner
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          architecture: 'arm64'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller pyserial pillow
          # Install project dependencies if requirements.txt exists
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Convert icon to ICNS
        run: |
          mkdir -p icon.iconset
          # Use sips to convert png to various sizes required for icns
          if [ -f icon.png ]; then
            sips -z 16 16 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_16x16.png
            sips -z 32 32 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_16x16@2x.png
            sips -z 32 32 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_32x32.png
            sips -z 64 64 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_32x32@2x.png
            sips -z 128 128 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_128x128.png
            sips -z 256 256 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_128x128@2x.png
            sips -z 256 256 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_256x256.png
            sips -z 512 512 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_256x256@2x.png
            sips -z 512 512 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_512x512.png
            sips -z 1024 1024 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png
            iconutil -c icns icon.iconset
            mv icon.iconset/icon.icns .
          else
            echo "Warning: icon.png not found, skipping ICNS conversion"
          fi

      - name: Build PyInstaller App
        run: |
          # Build using the spec file if it exists, otherwise use default command
          if [ -f obi-macos.spec ]; then
            pyinstaller obi-macos.spec
          else
            # Fallback if spec file is missing during initial setup
            pyinstaller --name "OpenBatteryInformation" \
                        --windowed \
                        --icon=icon.icns \
                        --clean \
                        main.py # Adjust main.py to your actual entry point
          fi

      - name: Create DMG
        run: |
          # Install create-dmg if not available via pip or brew
          pip install create-dmg
          
          APP_NAME="OpenBatteryInformation"
          DMG_NAME="OpenBatteryInformation.dmg"
          
          # Create DMG from the app bundle
          create-dmg \
            --volname "${APP_NAME}" \
            --window-size 600 400 \
            --icon-size 100 \
            --icon "${APP_NAME}.app" 200 190 \
            --app-drop-link 400 190 \
            "${DMG_NAME}" \
            "dist/${APP_NAME}.app"

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: macos-arm64-dmg
          path: OpenBatteryInformation.dmg
          retention-days: 5
```
